name: io.github.ipvolt/account
title: ipvolt account
description: Mobile proxies on sale at ipvolt with prices; with an API key: balance, rent, extend, rotate IP.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. What is on sale and its prices need no credential. For the account tools, set this to the word Bearer, a space and an ipvolt API key from your dashboard. Renting and extending spend the prepaid balance after a confirmation step; a read-only key cannot spend.
